details.effect: While this card is on your field, any Machina card you play from the EX area costs 1 less. 4 times per turn, when you play a Machina card, select an enemy follower on the field and deal it 1 damage.

issues: Passive cost reduction is incorrectly scoped: it should apply only while this card is on your field to Machina cards played from the EX area. Encode the passive ability using effect {"op":"exAreaPlayCostReduction","amount":1} without an unsupported top-level filter, or otherwise ensure the reduction is limited to Machina cards from EX area.

The triggered damage ability is missing the source-zone restriction from the English text: it should trigger while this card is on your field when you play a Machina card. Encode it as a field passive/onCardPlayed-style grant tied to this card being on the field.

The trigger should be '4 times per turn' when you play a Machina card; the current grantOnCardPlayed encoding is acceptable for the count, but the ability should not be a generic passive without clearly representing the field-based trigger condition.

details.effect: Ward. [fanfare] Look at the top 5 cards of your deck. You may summon an amulet that costs 2 or less from among them. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order. [act] [engage]: Select an amulet on your field and destroy it.

issues: The activated ability target is encoded incorrectly: it should select an amulet on your field, but the parsed target uses allyFieldCard with an unsupported nested filter. Encode it using a valid target/effect combination that correctly restricts the chosen target to an amulet you control and then destroys it.

details.effect: [act] [engage]: Put a Puppet token into your EX area. [act] [engage], banish a Puppet from your EX area: Draw a card.

issues: The second activated ability cost is encoded incorrectly: banishing a Puppet from your EX area should use the implemented activated cost shape with banishFromExArea containing both filter and count, e.g. {"engage":true,"banishFromExArea":{"filter":{"identityName":"Puppet"},"count":1}} or equivalent valid EX-area Puppet filter, instead of unsupported fields banishCount and a bare trait object.
